content.title: User-friendly documentation overhaul
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

Replace auto-generated TypeDoc docs with hand-written, user-friendly markdown documentation in docs/markdown/. Remove TypeDoc tooling entirely. 8 new doc sections: overview, getting started, authentication, issue object, hierarchy & blockages, storing in git, CLI reference, JS reference. Docusaurus setup is future work.
